_design: A Series A sheet whose validity weeks have run out does not close on its own. The sheet stays in active_sheets, due (TermSheet.is_decision_due), and this card asks for the answer: sit down now, or decline and the fund is closed for good. Two options and no third - no 'later' row, and an interrupt, so it cannot be dismissed or deferred. Decline is the PLAYER'S answer, so decline_offer closes the fund without counting a rejection. HOURLY and critical so that two sheets closing in the same week arrive one after the other that week: the decision_sheet selector binds one due fund at a time, the first answer frees it, and the next hourly sweep binds the other. cooldown_weeks 1 per entity: if a sitting somehow ends with the sheet still due, the card comes back the next week rather than never. The condition also waits on funding.table_sitting_open, so the card asks only at an hour when the table can open; the pump checks it again on the way to the screen. Sit down still carries the same lock with its reason, for a card that reaches the screen after a sitting's hours have run. No speaker - this is the plain fact of the offer, not Frank's voice (his lines for this surface are an open decision in docs/ACIK_ISLER/ACIK_KARARLAR.md).

tr.title: VC_EV_DECISION_TITLE
tr.body:
{investor} teklifinin süresi doldu. Fon şimdi bir cevap bekliyor.

Tahmini şartlar: değerleme {seam:investor.est_valuation} · pay {seam:investor.est_dilution}.

Masaya oturursan şartlar netleşir. Reddedersen bu fon kalıcı olarak kapanır.

en.title: VC_EV_DECISION_TITLE
en.body:
The offer from {investor} has run its time. The fund wants an answer now.

Estimated terms: valuation {seam:investor.est_valuation} · equity {seam:investor.est_dilution}.

Sit down and the terms become exact. Decline and this fund is closed for good.
